name: Snowbell
lore: The winter courier’s lead reindeer knows how to find a safe path through the thickest storm.
passive: Surefooted: keep moving to build momentum for your next Antler Sweep.

technique.name: Driftkick
technique.description: Kick a snowball that briefly slows its first target. Full Surefooted momentum adds 8 damage and strengthens its slow.

attack.name: Driftkick
attack.description: Kick a snowball that briefly slows its first target. Full Surefooted momentum adds 8 damage and strengthens its slow.
attack.ui_brief: Kick a snowball that briefly slows its first target. Full Surefooted momentum adds 8 damage and strengthens its slow.

final_technique.name: Whiteout Escort
final_technique.description: Steer your flight to leave shielding snow. Land with a pulse that heals allies for 20 and boosts their speed for 1.8 seconds.

attack.name: Whiteout Escort
attack.description: Steer your flight to leave shielding snow. Land with a pulse that heals allies for 20 and boosts their speed for 1.8 seconds.
attack.ui_brief: Steer your flight to leave shielding snow. Land with a pulse that heals allies for 20 and boosts their speed for 1.8 seconds.

primary.name: Antler Sweep
primary.description: A close sweep that pushes enemies aside.
primary.ui_brief: A close sweep that pushes enemies aside.

secondary.name: Sleighbreak Charge
secondary.description: Charge along the ground and leave a trail that speeds allies.
secondary.ui_brief: Charge along the ground and leave a trail that speeds allies.

special.name: Flying Reindeer
special.description: Rise off the ground, then steer for 4 seconds. Falling snow heals allies and slows enemies. A countdown and ground ring mark the landing slam.
special.ui_brief: Rise off the ground, then steer for 4 seconds. Falling snow heals allies and slows enemies. A countdown and ground ring mark the landing slam.
